style: STYLE LOCK — "Moonlit Meadow", art set BDS-01, scene backgrounds: cozy storybook illustration for children aged 3 to 7, fully original. Flat vector illustration: solid flat colour fills, at most one darker shade per colour as a simple hard-edged shape, no gradients, no textures, no noise, no glow. Smooth, uniform dark plum outline (#2B2A3A), the same thickness everywhere. Warm gentle palette: cream #FFF9F0, soft indigo #5B6CFF, mint #3DBE8B, honey #FFC93C, coral #E5565B, lilac #9B6BE8, apricot #FF8A3D, with soft pastel tints. Rounded, chunky, friendly shapes, nothing sharp, spooky, messy or menacing. Calm, tidy and well lit, like a page of a bedtime picture book.
format: FORMAT: one landscape background, aspect ratio 16:9, eye-level view seen from a child's height. Keep the lower middle third of the picture open and uncluttered (a clear floor area): a story character is placed there later. Put the main objects to the left, the right and the back.
avoid: DO NOT include: people, children, faces, hands, animals, creatures, characters, toys with faces, text, letters, numbers, labels, signs with writing, logos, watermarks, frames, needles, blood, sharp tools, scissors close up, anything scary, dark shadows, photorealism, 3D render look.
